meaning:
§ Beer = "well"
an oasis rest in desert during the Exodus

renderings.kjv: And from thence they went to Beer

elsewhere.note: From there they traveled to Beer; that is the well of which Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather the people together, and I will give them water.”
Jotham ran away and fled, and went to Beer and lived there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
